name: io.github.zachshallbetter/adobe-mcp-suite
title: Adobe MCP Suite
description: Drive Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, and Premiere Pro from one local MCP server, with tools that work across apps.

environmentVariables.name: ADOBE_MCP_APPS
environmentVariables.description: Applications to load, comma-separated: indesign, illustrator, photoshop, aftereffects, premiere. Default all five

environmentVariables.name: INDESIGN_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories InDesign tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: ILLUSTRATOR_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories Illustrator tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: PHOTOSHOP_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories Photoshop tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: AFTEREFFECTS_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories After Effects tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: PREMIERE_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories Premiere Pro tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: PREMIERE_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Loopback port used to connect the Premiere Pro UXP plugin; defaults to 3011

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional shared secret for the local Premiere Pro UXP bridge
